title: Preparation of Bulk TiZrNbMoV and NbTiAlTaV High-Entropy Alloys by Powder Sintering
process_description: prepared by mixing high purity metal powder (99.9% purity, 10 micron particle size) homogeneously and hot pressing sintering at 30 MPa for 4 h at 1300°C in high purity argon environment
